title: Ok, but some features are like an afterthought.
body:
As the app insisted, I shall. I like the app. It's ok. But the locking mechanism has been tacked on. I know this because there is a faint flash of data before it asks for my code, as the app loads up and then suddenly, "Oh, damn! Almost forgot! Password!" This coupled with the desire to be rated now has me locked out of the app because the lock screen forces the keyboard open and the rating request covers the page, but the keyboard also covers the rating request. So I can't close the request and I can't unlock the app.

Here's your rating, HabitBull. :)
